# KPN / ThingPark fixtures

Shapes follow the ThingPark application server JSON documentation (`DevEUI_uplink`,
`DevEUI_downlink_Sent`). Values are invented: the DevEUI is the local simulator's, the payload is
an OpenCollar port 2 frame. Recorded events from a KPN account replace these when the live run
happens (phase 7 input); keep the origin in this file.
